Design a polished cheerful community picnic flyer, designed to be reformatted into portrait 4:5. Warm cream paper background, green grass, gingham picnic blanket, illustrated picnic basket, summer flowers and leafy branches around the edges. Elegant bold highly readable typography, restrained forest green and warm coral palette, generous whitespace. Centered typographic layout with EXACTLY these four lines, verbatim, and absolutely no other text, logos, lettering, or watermarks:
Community Picnic
12 June 2027
12:00–15:00
Maple Park, East Gate
Keep all text in the central region, with title largest, date and time medium, location smaller but readable. Professional flat editorial illustration.
